output: Thanks for raising this, and you're right that model building has a learning curve, especially for people who don't work in finance day to day. Most non-finance users should start by entering and reviewing numbers rather than designing models. Input views are organized by role, so your headteachers would see the fields they own, and onboarding includes admin training. Routine model changes are then handled by a trained internal admin rather than a consultant. One customer story shows how this works: [PLACEHOLDER] operations team updated its own headcount drivers after admin training. If it helps, we could set up a hands-on session where two of your non-finance budget owners complete a real input task in a sandbox, so you can judge the experience yourself.

</quote>
